objectives.text:
Put a Pyramid into zone 2 and another one into zone 4. Put the Pyramidallion to the side.
If a lead hero has the Pyramidallion at the end of a round, you win.

Whenever a hero uses Pyramid Aura, its controller returns an Exhaust Action card from their discard pile to their hand.
